commands.review_summary:
Changes iOS gateway and onboarding status precedence to retain reconnect errors, clear them on selected target changes, add regression coverage, remove unused connection/watch helpers, and refresh native localization metadata.

PR surface: Other +160. Total +160 across 11 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level for the review defects: setup-code connection with an existing local failure, another Retry or Trust tap while reconnecting, and a different-target TLS preflight provide concrete paths. No live simulator artifact demonstrates them.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] An iOS owner must confirm the presentation policy, resolve the dirty base, require fixes for the three state-transition defects, and obtain contributor-owned visible proof.

target.title: fix(ios): keep reconnect errors visible
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where iOS users reconnecting to a gateway would see the previous connection error replaced by “Reconnecting…” before they could read or inspect it.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the retained gateway problem ahead of reconnect progress in both shared status presentation and onboarding. Successful connections still win immediately, reconnect progress still appears when there is no prior error, and explicitly switching gateways clears the previous target's problem.

This is AI-assisted work. The change and its state precedence were reviewed manually and with the repository autoreview gate.

## User Impact

The most recent gateway error stays visible while iOS reconnects in the background, giving users time to read the message or open its details. No reconnect behavior or retry timing changes.

## Evidence

- Focused iOS simulator test: 77 tests across `GatewayStatusBuilderTests`, `OnboardingConnectPhaseTests`, and `GatewayConnectionControllerTests` passed at `b7eec503cbc1c5a15383039fa632626bec5a122b`; the four code/refactor commits are patch-identical at rebased head `252f85ced0dcf0fdde819aca4338f4dcd1b4898f`.
- Same-target and changed-target regression coverage verifies that reconnecting preserves the previous error while selecting another gateway clears it.
- Current exact-head CI: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29230076166 (in progress)
- Current exact-head iOS Periphery: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29230076119 (in progress)
- Current exact-head shared-kit Periphery: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29230076116 (in progress)
- Fresh post-rebase autoreview is clean with no accepted/actionable findings; patch correct (0.91).
- `swiftformat --lint` passed for all touched Swift files; `node --import tsx scripts/native-app-i18n.ts check` reported no drift; `git diff --check` passed.
- Real-device/source-blind visual proof unavailable: no physical iPhone was attached.
